links.comparator_used: State-of-the-art ML model outputting every sleep-stage prediction without uncertainty-based flagging or expert review of uncertain epochs
links.outcome: Five-stage sleep-scoring accuracy on wearable EEG data
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 63.9% to 71.2% with the uncertainty-centred U-PASS pipeline that flags uncertain predictions for expert review
links.tradeoff: Manual review by sleep specialists without specific training for sleep staging on wearable EEG proved ineffective, so the review step depends on expert training.
links.quote: This increased the five-stage sleep-scoring accuracy of a state-of-the-art machine learning model from 63.9% to 71.2% on our dataset.

design_hint: uncertainty quantification with expert review of uncertain predictions
